interfaces.contract: Carrier outer 17.8 x 12.8 mm, inner channel 15.4 x 10.4 mm, inside nominal shell ID 23.0 mm; exact PCB outline and keepouts remain unfrozen.
interfaces.safeState: No forced assembly; quote-only until native fit/interference proof.

interfaces.contract: Momentary normally-open switch at global Z=72 +/-0.5 mm; recessed at least 0.6 mm; grounds dedicated ARM_N through 1 kOhm with 100 kOhm pull-up.
interfaces.safeState: Stuck-low is a fault; release requests disarm; no command enable without continuous hold.

interfaces.contract: Antenna end faces nonconductive rear region; mechanical keepout global Z=5..30 mm, radius 11.5 mm; no metal, battery, GFRP, shielding or harness in the conservative envelope.
interfaces.safeState: No RF pass claim; final vendor-rule overlay and representative hand/enclosure test required.

interfaces.contract: 5 V sink-only USB-C feeds BQ25185; protected 1S LiPo with 10 kOhm NTC; TPS63900 creates 3.3 V logic rail.
interfaces.safeState: Charge prohibited until exact cell/protection/NTC limits and thermal behavior are verified.

interfaces.contract: BLE 1M, LE Secure Connections plus application AES-CCM, direction/device/session binding and monotonic anti-replay sequence.
interfaces.safeState: Invalid, stale, duplicate or unauthenticated packets cause no output and do not renew arm lease.

interfaces.contract: J2 exposes GND, external VREF_IO 3.3/5 V, UART TX/RX and PWM/AUX. It is signal-only; SBUS requires an externally reviewed inverter.
interfaces.safeState: Outputs default inactive; no propulsion energy or arming/primary flight control.

interfaces.contract: J3 is floating collector/emitter, external pull-up, target 3.3..24 V and <=10 mA subject to exact CTR validation.
interfaces.safeState: Signal isolation only; no mains conductor on PCB or inside enclosure.

interfaces.contract: J4 common-ground 5..12 V low-side channel, provisional 1 A continuous / 2 A 100 ms; external supply protection and inductive flyback required.
interfaces.safeState: No mains and no flight propulsion; hardware pulldown holds gate inactive on reset.

interfaces.contract: Only the certified product's low-voltage control input may connect; all mains wiring, enclosure, creepage and installation are external.
interfaces.safeState: Qualified electrical professional review mandatory; no mains enters AICAD PCB/enclosure.

interfaces.contract: Only non-flight-critical AUX or telemetry signal; no motor, ESC power, arming or primary flight controls.
interfaces.safeState: Integrator-configured failsafe; ground and restrained-prop test before any flight.
